#### DEFINITIVE CLUSTER ANNOTATION ####
####cluster annotation
####colors setup

```{r}
#### DEFINITIVE CLUSTER ANNOTATION ####

# ============================================================
# 1. Cluster ID -> long name
# ============================================================

cluster_labels <- c(
  "1"  = "Myofibroblasts",
  "2"  = "Early myocytes",
  "3"  = "Myogenic progenitors",
  "4"  = "Slow-twitch myotubes",
  "5"  = "Pre-myocytes",
  "6"  = "Non-cycling myoblasts",
  "7"  = "Late myocytes",
  "8"  = "Cycling myoblasts",
  "9"  = "Fusing myotubes",
  "10" = "Early myotubes",
  "11" = "Stromal cells"
)

# ============================================================
# 2. Cluster ID -> short name
# ============================================================

cluster_labels_short <- c(
  "1"  = "MF",
  "2"  = "eMC",
  "3"  = "MP",
  "4"  = "sMT",
  "5"  = "preMC",
  "6"  = "ncMB",
  "7"  = "lMC",
  "8"  = "cMB",
  "9"  = "fMT",
  "10" = "eMT",
  "11" = "SC"
)

# ============================================================
# 3. Biological order from Excel
# ============================================================

cluster_order_ids <- c(
  "4", "10", "9", "7", "2", "6",
  "8", "5", "3", "1", "11"
)

cluster_order_names <- unname(
  cluster_labels[cluster_order_ids]
)

cluster_order_short <- unname(
  cluster_labels_short[cluster_order_ids]
)

cluster_labels_ordered <- cluster_labels[
  cluster_order_ids
]

# ============================================================
# 4. Colours: retain association with cluster ID
# ============================================================

my_colors_cl_nb <- c(
  "1"  = "#000000",
  "2"  = "#24ff24",
  "3"  = "#CC79A7",
  "4"  = "#D55E00",
  "5"  = "#F0E442",
  "6"  = "#0072B2",
  "7"  = "#b6dbff",
  "8"  = "#ff6db6",
  "9"  = "#56B4E9",
  "10" = "#009E73",
  "11" = "#004949"
)

my_colors <- setNames(
  unname(my_colors_cl_nb[names(cluster_labels)]),
  unname(cluster_labels)
)

my_colors_ordered <- my_colors[
  cluster_order_names
]

cluster_name_pal <- my_colors
```

####aggiorna cluster tab

```{r}
cluster_tab$monocle_cluster <- as.character(cluster_tab$monocle_cluster)
cluster_tab$cluster_name <- unname(cluster_labels[cluster_tab$monocle_cluster])
cluster_tab$cluster_name_short <- unname(cluster_labels_short[cluster_tab$monocle_cluster])
cluster_tab$cluster_color <- unname(my_colors_cl_nb[cluster_tab$monocle_cluster])
cluster_tab$cluster_name <- factor(cluster_tab$cluster_name,levels = cluster_order_names)
cluster_tab$cluster_name_short <- factor(cluster_tab$cluster_name_short,levels = cluster_order_short)
```

#aggiorna meta
```{r}

meta$time=meta$sample
meta$time <- dplyr::recode(
  as.character(meta$time),
  "GERALTd4"  = "D4/pre",
  "OPTIOXd4"          = "D4/pre",
  "WTpre"          = "D4/pre",
  "LONZApre"          = "D4/pre",
  "GERALTd7"  = "D7/post",
  "OPTIOXd7"          = "D7/post",
  "WTmyod4"          = "D7/post",
  "LONZApost"          = "D7/post",
  .default      = as.character(meta$time)
)

meta$monocle_clusters <- as.character(meta$monocle_clusters)
meta$cluster_name <- unname(cluster_labels[meta$monocle_clusters])
meta$cluster_name_short <- unname(cluster_labels_short[meta$monocle_clusters])
meta$cluster_color <- unname(my_colors_cl_nb[meta$monocle_clusters])
meta$cluster_name <- factor(meta$cluster_name,levels = cluster_order_names)
meta$cluster_name_short <- factor(meta$cluster_name_short,levels = cluster_order_short)
meta$monocle_clusters <- factor(meta$monocle_clusters,levels = cluster_order_ids)
```

#update cds

```{r}
stopifnot(
  all(colnames(cds) %in% rownames(meta))
)

meta_for_cds <- meta[
  colnames(cds),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

stopifnot(
  identical(
    rownames(meta_for_cds),
    colnames(cds)
  )
)

SummarizedExperiment::colData(cds)$monocle_clusters <-meta_for_cds$monocle_clusters
SummarizedExperiment::colData(cds)$cluster_name <-meta_for_cds$cluster_name
SummarizedExperiment::colData(cds)$cluster_name_short <-meta_for_cds$cluster_name_short
SummarizedExperiment::colData(cds)$cluster_color <-meta_for_cds$cluster_color
```

#####final UMAP plots

```{r}
##### FINAL UMAP PLOTS #####

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stable order and colours for final UMAPs
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

meta$cluster_name <- factor(
  as.character(meta$cluster_name),
  levels = cluster_order_names
)

meta$cell_type <- factor(
  as.character(meta$cell_type),
  levels = c("WT", "LONZA", "OPTIOX", "GERALT")
)

meta$timepoint <- factor(
  as.character(meta$timepoint),
  levels = c("pre fusion", "D4", "D7", "post fusion")
)

meta$time <- factor(
  meta$time,
  levels = c("D4/pre", "D7/post")
)

# cluster_name_pal was defined from the new cluster annotations:
# cluster_name_pal <- my_colors

stopifnot(
  all(levels(meta$cluster_name) %in% names(cluster_name_pal))
)


# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# UMAP - annotated cluster names
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

p_umap <- ggplot(
  meta,
  aes(x = UMAP_1_monocle, y = UMAP_2_monocle)
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = cluster_name),
    size = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "UMAP 1",
    y = "UMAP 2",
    title = "Annotated clusters"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Cluster",
    values = cluster_name_pal,
    breaks = cluster_order_names,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.5
    )
  )

p_umap

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(fname_prefix_UMAP, "_UMAP.pdf"),
  plot = p_umap,
  width = 7,
  height = 5
)


# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# UMAP - by cell type and combined time
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

p_umap_all <- ggplot(
  meta,
  aes(x = UMAP_1_monocle, y = UMAP_2_monocle)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = cluster_name),
    size = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    x = "UMAP 1",
    y = "UMAP 2",
    title = "Annotated clusters") +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Cluster",
    values = cluster_name_pal,
    breaks = cluster_order_names,
    drop = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(time ~ cell_type) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.line = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.5))

p_umap_all

ggsave(filename = paste0(
    fname_prefix_UMAP,
    "_UMAP_cluster_names_all.pdf"),
  plot = p_umap_all,
  width = 10,
```

###DEG volcano plots lonza vs GERALT cl4 vs cl9  and cl4 GERALT vs OPTIOX cl7

```{r}
# Cutoffs
sig_level <- 0.01
fc_level  <- log2(2)
fc_level2 <- -log2(2)
N <- 20

DEG_4vs9 <- de_stats %>% select(geneID,q_value_4vs9,logFC_4vs9) %>%
  mutate(
    regulation = case_when(
      q_value_4vs9 < sig_level & logFC_4vs9 >= fc_level  ~ "up",
      q_value_4vs9 < sig_level & logFC_4vs9 <= fc_level2 ~ "down",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    significant = regulation != "other",
    log10_q_value = -log10(
      pmax(q_value_4vs9, .Machine$double.xmin)
    )
  )

DEG_4vs7 <- de_stats %>% select(geneID,q_value_4vs7,logFC_4vs7) %>%
  mutate(
    regulation = case_when(
      q_value_4vs7 < sig_level & logFC_4vs7 >= fc_level  ~ "up",
      q_value_4vs7 < sig_level & logFC_4vs7 <= fc_level2 ~ "down",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    significant = regulation != "other",
    log10_q_value = -log10(
      pmax(q_value_4vs7, .Machine$double.xmin)
    )
  )

##calculate top genes

top_genes_4vs9 <- DEG_4vs9 %>%
  filter(significant) %>%
  arrange(q_value_4vs9, desc(abs(logFC_4vs9))) %>%
  slice_head(n = N)

top_genes_4vs7 <- DEG_4vs7 %>%
  filter(significant) %>%
  arrange(q_value_4vs7, desc(abs(logFC_4vs7))) %>%
  slice_head(n = N)
```

### NOVO signatures in the 4vs9 and 4vs7 comparisons

For each comparison, all genes are shown as a grey background. Only significant
genes from one `gs_NOVO` signature at a time are coloured and labelled.

```{r}

### NOVO signatures in the 4vs9 and 4vs7 comparisons

# Define the cluster order first
cluster_order_ids <- names(cluster_labels)[
  match(cluster_order_names, cluster_labels)
]

cluster_labels_ordered <- cluster_labels[
  cluster_order_ids
]

# Optional alias
cluster_name_pal <- my_colors


# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOVO gene-to-signature table
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

stopifnot(
  exists("gs_NOVO"),
  is.list(gs_NOVO),
  length(gs_NOVO) > 0
)

gs_gene_table_NOVO <- stack(gs_NOVO) %>%
  transmute(
    geneID = as.character(values),
    signature = as.character(ind)
  ) %>%
  distinct()


# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Comparisons
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

NOVO_comparisons <- list(
  `4vs9` = list(
    deg = DEG_4vs9,
    q_col = "q_value_4vs9",
    fc_col = "logFC_4vs9",
    title = "GERALT Cl4 versus Lonza Cl9",
    comparator = "Lonza Cl9"
  ),
  `4vs7` = list(
    deg = DEG_4vs7,
    q_col = "q_value_4vs7",
    fc_col = "logFC_4vs7",
    title = "GERALT Cl4 versus OPTi-OX Cl7",
    comparator = "OPTi-OX Cl7"
  )
)


# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Run both comparisons
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

NOVO_results <- list()

for (comparison_name in names(NOVO_comparisons)) {

  # These variables must be defined inside the loop
  comparison <- NOVO_comparisons[[comparison_name]]

  DEG_current <- comparison$deg
  q_col <- comparison$q_col
  fc_col <- comparison$fc_col
  comparator_label <- comparison$comparator
  comparison_title <- comparison$title

  # Check required columns
  required_columns <- c(
    "geneID",
    "significant",
    "regulation",
    "log10_q_value",
    q_col,
    fc_col
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    colnames(DEG_current)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      comparison_name,
      " is missing these columns: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # NOVO genes found in the DEG table
  DEG_NOVO <- DEG_current %>%
    inner_join(
      gs_gene_table_NOVO,
      by = "geneID"
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      signature,
      .data[[q_col]],
      desc(abs(.data[[fc_col]]))
    )

  significant_NOVO <- DEG_NOVO %>%
    filter(significant %in% TRUE)

  NOVO_summary <- DEG_NOVO %>%
    group_by(signature) %>%
    summarise(
      genes_in_DEG_table = n_distinct(geneID),
      significant_genes = n_distinct(
        geneID[significant %in% TRUE]
      ),
      higher_in_GERALT_Cl4 = n_distinct(
        geneID[
          significant %in% TRUE &
            regulation == "up"
        ]
      ),
      higher_in_comparator = n_distinct(
        geneID[
          significant %in% TRUE &
            regulation == "down"
        ]
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      comparison = comparison_name,
      comparator = comparator_label,
      .before = 1
    )

  print(NOVO_summary)
  print(significant_NOVO)

  write.csv(
    DEG_NOVO,
    paste0(
      fname_prefix_csv,
      "_",
      comparison_name,
      "_NOVO_all_genes.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    significant_NOVO,
    paste0(
      fname_prefix_csv,
      "_",
      comparison_name,
      "_NOVO_significant_genes.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    NOVO_summary,
    paste0(
      fname_prefix_csv,
      "_",
      comparison_name,
      "_NOVO_signature_summary.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )


  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # One volcano plot per NOVO signature
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------

  volcano_list <- list()

  for (signature_name in names(gs_NOVO)) {

    genes_to_highlight <- DEG_NOVO %>%
      filter(
        signature == signature_name,
        significant %in% TRUE
      )

    volcano_signature <- ggplot(
      DEG_current,
      aes(
        x = .data[[fc_col]],
        y = log10_q_value
      )
    ) +
      geom_point(
        colour = "grey80",
        size = 1.3,
        alpha = 0.55
      ) +
      geom_point(
        data = genes_to_highlight,
        aes(fill = regulation),
        shape = 21,
        size = 3,
        stroke = 0.7,
        colour = "black"
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c(
          up = "#CC79A7",
          down = "#009E73"
        ),
        breaks = c("up", "down"),
        labels = c(
          up = "Higher in GERALT Cl4",
          down = paste("Higher in", comparator_label)
        ),
        name = NULL,
        drop = FALSE
      ) +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
        data = genes_to_highlight,
        aes(label = geneID),
        size = 3,
        box.padding = 0.3,
        point.padding = 0.2,
        segment.color = "grey50",
        segment.linewidth = 0.2,
        max.overlaps = Inf
      ) +
      geom_hline(
        yintercept = -log10(sig_level),
        linetype = "dotted"
      ) +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = c(-fc_level, fc_level),
        linetype = "dotted"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = comparison_title,
        subtitle = paste0(
          signature_name,
          ": ",
          nrow(genes_to_highlight),
          " significant genes"
        ),
        x = "Average log2 fold change",
        y = expression(-log[10]("adjusted p-value"))
      ) +
      theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "top",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
      )

    volcano_list[[signature_name]] <- volcano_signature

    print(volcano_signature)

    safe_signature_name <- gsub(
      "[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+",
      "_",
      signature_name
    )

    ggsave(
      filename = paste0(
        fname_prefix_dotplot,
        "_",
        comparison_name,
        "_NOVO_",
        safe_signature_name,
        ".pdf"
      ),
      plot = volcano_signature,
      width = 8,
      height = 6
    )
  }

  NOVO_results[[comparison_name]] <- list(
    all_genes = DEG_NOVO,
    significant_genes = significant_NOVO,
    summary = NOVO_summary,
    volcanoes = volcano_list
  )
}

NOVO_results[["4vs7"]]$summary

names(NOVO_results[["4vs9"]]$volcanoes)
```

####make heatmap function
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(viridisLite)
library(grid)

make_NOVO_heatmap_cds <- function(
    cds,
    group_values,
    groups_to_keep,
    group_labels = groups_to_keep,
    heatmap_title,
    palette_option = "cividis"
) {

  # Normalized log-expression from Monocle
  expression_matrix <- monocle3::normalized_counts(
    cds
  )

  # Ensure identical cell order
  common_cells <- intersect(
    colnames(expression_matrix),
    names(group_values)
  )

  expression_matrix <- expression_matrix[
    ,
    common_cells,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  group_values <- as.character(
    group_values[common_cells]
  )

  # Select requested cells
  cells_to_keep <- !is.na(group_values) &
    group_values %in% groups_to_keep

  expression_matrix <- expression_matrix[
    ,
    cells_to_keep,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  group_values <- factor(
    group_values[cells_to_keep],
    levels = groups_to_keep
  )

  # Check that every requested group is present
  missing_groups <- setdiff(
    groups_to_keep,
    unique(as.character(group_values))
  )

  if (length(missing_groups) > 0) {
    stop(
      "These groups are absent from cds: ",
      paste(missing_groups, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # NOVO genes present in cds
  requested_genes <- unique(
    NOVO_gene_table_heatmap$geneID
  )

  genes_available <- intersect(
    requested_genes,
    rownames(expression_matrix)
  )

  genes_missing <- setdiff(
    requested_genes,
    genes_available
  )

  if (length(genes_missing) > 0) {
    message(
      length(genes_missing),
      " NOVO genes are absent from cds: ",
      paste(genes_missing, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  if (length(genes_available) == 0) {
    stop("None of the requested NOVO genes is present in cds.")
  }

  expression_matrix <- expression_matrix[
    genes_available,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  # Average normalized expression within each group
  group_design <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(
    ~ 0 + group_values
  )

  average_expression <- expression_matrix %*%
    group_design

  average_expression <- sweep(
    average_expression,
    MARGIN = 2,
    STATS = Matrix::colSums(group_design),
    FUN = "/"
  )

  average_expression <- as.matrix(
    average_expression
  )

  colnames(average_expression) <- groups_to_keep
  colnames(average_expression) <- group_labels

  # Gene-wise z-score
  heatmap_zscore <- t(
    scale(t(average_expression))
  )

  # Genes without variation among groups
  heatmap_zscore[!is.finite(heatmap_zscore)] <- 0

  # Category and row order
  heatmap_rows <- NOVO_gene_table_heatmap %>%
    dplyr::filter(geneID %in% rownames(heatmap_zscore)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(signature, geneID)

  heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_zscore[
    heatmap_rows$geneID,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  # Duplicate genes belonging to different signatures need unique row names
  rownames(heatmap_matrix) <- make.unique(
    heatmap_rows$geneID
  )

  colour_limit <- max(
    1,
    abs(heatmap_matrix),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  if (palette_option == "turbo") {

    heatmap_colours <- circlize::colorRamp2(
      seq(-colour_limit, colour_limit, length.out = 101),
      viridisLite::turbo(101)
    )

  } else if (palette_option == "viridis") {

    heatmap_colours <- circlize::colorRamp2(
      seq(-colour_limit, colour_limit, length.out = 101),
      viridisLite::viridis(101)
    )

  } else {

    heatmap_colours <- circlize::colorRamp2(
      seq(-colour_limit, colour_limit, length.out = 101),
      viridisLite::cividis(101)
    )
  }

  ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
    heatmap_matrix,
    name = "Gene\nz-score",
    col = heatmap_colours,

    row_split = heatmap_rows$signature,
    row_title_rot = 0,
    row_gap = grid::unit(2.5, "mm"),

    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,

    show_row_names = TRUE,
    row_labels = heatmap_rows$geneID,
    row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),

    show_column_names = TRUE,
    column_names_rot = 0,
    column_names_gp = grid::gpar(
      fontsize = 10,
      fontface = "bold"
    ),

    column_title = heatmap_title,
    column_title_gp = grid::gpar(
      fontsize = 13,
      fontface = "bold"
    ),

    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title = "Relative\nexpression",
      at = c(-colour_limit, 0, colour_limit),
      labels = c("Lower", "Mean", "Higher")
    ),

    border = TRUE
  )
}

cluster_values <- setNames(
  as.character(SummarizedExperiment::colData(cds)$monocle_clusters),
  colnames(cds)
)
group_values = cluster_values

sample_values <- setNames(
  as.character(SummarizedExperiment::colData(cds)$sample),
  colnames(cds)
)


#####per sample (not great)
```

###also make a dotplot for the NOVO genes

```{r}

NOVO_signature_labels <- c(
  slow_twitch_myofiber_NOVO =
    "Slow-twitch myofiber",
  fast_twitch_myofiber_NOVO =
    "Fast-twitch myofiber",
  skeletal_muscle_fiber_type_independent_NOVO =
    "Fiber-type-independent skeletal muscle",
  genes_not_in_mature_skeletal_muscle_NOVO =
    "Genes absent from mature skeletal muscle"
)

NOVO_signature_filenames <- c(
  slow_twitch_myofiber_NOVO =
    "slow_twitch",
  fast_twitch_myofiber_NOVO =
    "fast_twitch",
  skeletal_muscle_fiber_type_independent_NOVO =
    "fiber_type_independent",
  genes_not_in_mature_skeletal_muscle_NOVO =
    "not_in_mature_muscle"
)

make_NOVO_cluster_dotplot <- function(
    cds,
    genes,
    clusters_to_keep = c("4", "7", "9"),
    cluster_labels = c(
      "GERALT Cl4",
      "OPTi-OX Cl7",
      "LONZA Cl9"
    ),
    plot_title,
    max_dot_size = 6
) {

  genes_present <- unique(
    genes[genes %in% rownames(cds)]
  )

  genes_missing <- setdiff(
    unique(genes),
    genes_present
  )

  if (length(genes_missing) > 0) {
    message(
      plot_title,
      ": missing genes: ",
      paste(genes_missing, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  if (length(genes_present) == 0) {
    warning("No genes available for: ", plot_title)
    return(NULL)
  }

  cluster_values <- as.character(
    SummarizedExperiment::colData(cds)$monocle_clusters
  )

  cells_to_keep <- cluster_values %in% clusters_to_keep

  cds_signature <- cds[
    genes_present,
    cells_to_keep
  ]

  SummarizedExperiment::colData(
    cds_signature
  )$dotplot_cluster <- factor(
    as.character(
      SummarizedExperiment::colData(
        cds_signature
      )$monocle_clusters
    ),
    levels = clusters_to_keep,
    labels = cluster_labels
  )

  monocle3::plot_genes_by_group(
    cds_signature,
    markers = genes_present,
    group_cells_by = "dotplot_cluster",
    ordering_type = "none",
    max.size = max_dot_size
  ) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_viridis_c(
      option = "E",
      direction = 1,
      name = "Mean\nexpression"
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      size = "% expressing"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1
      ),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank()
    )
}

NOVO_dotplots_by_cluster <- list()
#visualize

NOVO_dotplots_by_cluster[["slow_twitch_myofiber_NOVO"]]

###save dotplots for each NOVO signature

for (signature_name in NOVO_categories) {

  signature_genes <- NOVO_gene_table_heatmap %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      as.character(signature) == signature_name
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(geneID)

  NOVO_dotplots_by_cluster[[signature_name]] <-
    make_NOVO_cluster_dotplot(
      cds = cds,
      genes = signature_genes,
      plot_title = NOVO_signature_labels[[signature_name]]
    )
}

for (signature_name in NOVO_categories) {

  current_plot <- NOVO_dotplots_by_cluster[[signature_name]]

  if (!is.null(current_plot)) {

    number_of_genes <- NOVO_gene_table_heatmap %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        as.character(signature) == signature_name,
        geneID %in% rownames(cds)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(geneID) %>%
      nrow()

    ggplot2::ggsave(
      filename = paste0(
        fname_prefix_dotplot,
        "_NOVO_",
        NOVO_signature_filenames[[signature_name]],
        "_dotplot_clusters_4_7_9.pdf"
      ),
      plot = current_plot,
      width = 5,
      height = max(4, 0.30 * number_of_genes + 2)
    )
  }
}
```
